title: Request an itemized billing review
formalNoticeClause: Please review the identified charges and provide documentation or a corrected statement.
mandatoryDemand: Please confirm receipt and explain your review process. This request does not itself establish a collection or credit-reporting stay.

title: Credit-account billing errors: eligibility matters
formalNoticeClause: Specific billing-error rights may apply to qualifying open-end credit accounts and timely notices. An ordinary hospital invoice is not automatically a qualifying credit account.
mandatoryDemand: Check applicability and notice requirements before relying on these protections. Acknowledgement and resolution deadlines differ.

title: Nonprofit hospital financial assistance
formalNoticeClause: If applicable, please provide your financial assistance policy, eligibility criteria and the method used to calculate amounts generally billed.
mandatoryDemand: Charge limits depend on the hospital and financial-assistance eligibility. UnBill's reference values do not calculate your hospital's AGB.

title: Surprise billing protections
formalNoticeClause: Certain emergency or out-of-network bills may qualify for federal surprise-billing protections, depending on coverage and circumstances.
mandatoryDemand: Review the actual insurance, network and service details before asserting a violation.
